text: マウンテン　バイクに　かいものカゴ　にあわない　もん

structure.jp: マウンテン　バイクに
かいものカゴ　にあわない　もん
structure.en: a shopping basket doesn't suit it, you know

patterns.name: 〜もの
patterns.explanation: もん is the short spoken form of もの at the end of a sentence. It gives your reason in a slightly childish, insisting way. にあわない もん = 'because it just doesn't suit it'.
